Job Title: Machine Learning Internship, Manipulation

Department: Robotics Software Engineering

Employment Type: Internship

Location: Houston, TX – Onsite

Who We Are

Persona AI is developing and commercializing rugged, multi-purpose humanoid robots that perform real work. Persona AI’s founding team has a decades-long history in humanoid robotics, bionics, and product development delivering robust hardware that has touched the stars, worked miles below the surface of the ocean, and even roamed Disney Parks. Our mission is focused squarely on shipping beautiful, reliable products at massive scale, while building a customer-focused team to achieve these aims.

About The Role

We're looking for a Machine Learning Intern (Manipulation) to help build Persona's machine learning models and infrastructure. We are primarily interested in candidates with experience and relevant projects in robot learning, but can be flexible depending on aptitude and energy.

As a Machine Learning Intern at Persona, you will have an incredible opportunity to work with humanoid robots and solve practical problems in the real world.

What You'll Do



- Work with the ML team to develop and improve machine learning models and the infrastructure.
- Monitor and evaluate the performance of models in the real world.
- Collaborate on the design and development of the Persona ML software stack and support its application in manipulation, navigation, locomotion, and perception.

What We're Looking For



- Courage and grit to tackle some of the hardest problems in embodied AI.
- Enthusiasm for working collaboratively in a high paced team environment.
- Experience with deep learning frameworks (Pytorch, JAX, TensorFlow, etc.)
- Experience with cloud computing to develop models, manage data, etc. (AWS, Azure, GCP)
- Strong understanding of the state of the art research in robot learning (behavior cloning and reinforcement learning for manipulation, world models, etc.).
- Understanding of the challenges of deploying neural network models in the real world.
- Capable of writing high-quality software.
- Thrive in fast-paced and ambiguous environments.
- Strong first principles thinker.

Preferred Or Bonus Qualifications



- An advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in computer science, robotics, machine learning, or another related field.
- Published papers at top ML/Robotics conferences (ICML, ICRA, CoRL, RSS, NeurIPS).

Our Internship Program

At Persona AI, Our Internship Program Gives You Direct, Hands-on Experience Building Cutting-edge Humanoid Robotics Alongside Industry Experts. We Offer Full-time Term Opportunities Across Three Upcoming Cohorts



- Fall 2026: August – December
- Spring 2027: January – May
- Summer 2027: May – August

As an intern, you’ll be paired 1:1 with a senior engineer mentor to accelerate your growth and guide your technical contributions. You will bond with your cohort through intern group lunches, gain cross-functional perspective during company-wide learning lunches, and unwind with fun team activities throughout the term. Whether you're working on advanced motion planning or real-world system testing, you'll tackle meaningful engineering challenges while immersing yourself in our collaborative startup culture.

Application Review Process

We evaluate applications as they are received rather than waiting for the posted deadline to pass. Positions for each cohort are filled on a first-come, first-served basis, and the portal will close as soon as all available roles are finalized.

To give yourself the best chance of securing a spot, keep these tips in mind:



- Apply Early: Submitting your resume as soon as possible ensures your materials are reviewed before interview slots fill up.
- Cohort Availability: Popular terms—especially Summer 2027—tend to reach capacity quickly.
- Rolling Interviews: Interviews and candidate evaluations begin immediately upon application receipt.

Persona AI is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Role Overview

At Qualcomm Canada, our Compute DSP/AI Processor team is looking for ASIC design and verification engineering interns interested in developing world-class machine learning technologies to transform industries and enrich lives. Under the supervision of an experienced engineer, the intern will contribute to design, verification, and modelling of ASIC HW IP (blocks) and sub-systems that may be used in machine learning end user applications. No background of any application space, such as AI or ML, is required. Through hands-on experience, you will learn a wide range of hardware design and verification techniques that transcend end user application.

 

By applying here, you are expressing interest in one of our many 2027 Qualcomm AI & Machine Learning Hardware Engineering internships. It is important to note that this is not a job posting for a specific role. We will review resumes on an ongoing basis, and a recruiter may reach out to you. 

 

Responsibilities May Include



- Implement modules in hardware design languages such as SystemVerilog and HLS C/C++/ SystemC 
- Implement tests at both module and sub-system levels using UVM and SystemVerilog 
- Identify interface requirements for modules developed by others and integrate them into larger subsystems using hardware design languages such as SystemVerilog
- Implement reference and bus-functional models using C++, SystemC, or Python 
- Implement design/verification methodology and automation using Python, Perl, or TCL 
- Implement and debug constraints to achieve netlist synthesis and static timing closure 
- Make significant contributions to silicon debug and analysis 
- Perform power analysis to identify/fix power bugs and contribute to power modelling/reporting
- Step into many phases of ASIC development from specification -> microarchitecture -> RTL coding -> verification -> synthesis -> optimization -> physical design -> post-silicon debug/correlation


Minimum Qualifications:   



- Digital Logic , Digital Design, Verilog/VHDL Strong problem-solving skills 
- Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills 
- Ability to work effectively as part of a team in a fast-paced environment 


  Preferred Qualifications



- Relevant academic or personal project experience 
- Relevant industry experience (internship, summer work, or others)  
- Computer and multimedia architecture knowledge (CPU, Bus interconnect, Audio, Display, Video, Camera, Graphics)  
- Knowledge of digital design building blocks (memories, FIFOs, clock gaters, technology node standard cells, etc.) and their implementation
- Knowledge of ASIC design and simulation tool sets (synthesis, simulator)  
- Knowledge of hardware description languages (Verilog/VHDL, HLS C/C++, SystemVerilog, SystemC)  
- Knowledge of verification methodology (UVM, assertions, coverage-driven constrained-random verification)  
- Knowledge of scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL, Shell)  
- Knowledge of version control (ClearCase, Git, etc.)


Education Requirements



- In study towards a bachelor’s degree in one of the following: Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Engineering Science, Computer Science, or related field
- For 16-month internships: must be available May or June 2027 - August or September 2028
- Expected graduation date of November 2028 or later.
- 1+ years of academic experience with programming languages such as C, C++, Python, etc


Qualcomm’s Internship Program

Our interns join world-class teams to help define and build what is next for mobility and the world. You’ll be paired with a mentor with visibility to your project and team, receive support from your manager, and have access to the entire Qualcomm employee community to ensure your success. To round out your internship, we host professional development workshops, social events, cross-functional speaker sessions, and an executive speaker series. In addition to competitive hourly pay and accrued vacation time, you will receive housing stipend to accommodate for the duration of your internship.

Application Process 

We will review resumes on an ongoing basis, and a recruiter may reach out to you. Advancing candidates may be invited to complete a timed HackerRank challenge to evaluate their technical skill set.

Export Control Notice

Qualcomm, like other companies, is experiencing significant delays in the export license process. Please be advised that if an export license is required, you may not be able to start work with Qualcomm until the license is granted, which may impact your ability to participate in the internship.

Role Overview

As an Intern on the Machine Learning Systems Team, you will work at the intersection of machine learning, compiler technology, and AI hardware architecture. You will collaborate closely with software, firmware, performance architecture, and hardware teams to improve the execution of state-of-the-art AI models on Qualcomm's Neural Processing Unit (NPU).

The ML Systems Team Focuses On Two Key Areas



- Development and evolution of production and next-generation ML/AI compilers for efficient mapping of AI workloads to Qualcomm hardware.
- Analysis of ML/AI algorithms and workloads to help shape future Qualcomm hardware and software innovations.


The team develops and maintains production compiler technology that ships as part of the Qualcomm AI Runtime SDK and is used to accelerate AI workloads across Qualcomm platforms. In addition, the team builds and utilizes performance modeling and simulation tools to evaluate current and future AI architectures.

This role provides a unique opportunity to develop both software and hardware expertise while working with state-of-the-art AI models, including large language models (LLMs), multimodal models, computer vision networks, and generative AI workloads. Interns will gain exposure to hardware/software co-design and help evaluate tradeoffs between performance, power efficiency, memory utilization, and programmability.

To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews independently. The use of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude, Gemini, or similar technologies) during interviews is not permitted unless explicitly authorized by the interviewer.

Responsibilities May Include

Analyze and Improve Performance



- Compile and optimize neural networks for execution on Qualcomm AI accelerators
- Analyze model performance and identify opportunities to improve compiler algorithms, runtime efficiency, and hardware utilization
- Prototype algorithms that enable AI workloads to execute with high performance and low power consumption on Qualcomm hardware
- Identify bottlenecks in compute and the memory hierarchy
- Recommend software and hardware enhancements to improve overall system performance and efficiency


Compiler and System Optimization



- Contribute to Qualcomm's ML compiler stack to improve performance, efficiency, scalability, and developer productivity.
- Explore and prototype optimization techniques for emerging AI workloads and state-of-the-art neural network architectures.
- Analyze ML workloads to help guide future hardware and software feature development.


Performance Modeling and Simulation



- Develop performance models and simulation infrastructure using Python, C, and C++.
- Evaluate current and future Qualcomm AI accelerators and predict workload performance before silicon is available.


Minimum Qualifications



- Proficiency in Python or C++
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- Detail-oriented with a passion for solving complex technical problems


Preferred Qualifications



- Strong knowledge of Python and/or C/C++
- Familiarity with object-oriented design principles
- Experience with software development tools and workflows, including Git, CI/CD systems, Linux, and SSH
- Experience with Algorithms and Data Structures
- Coursework, Research, or Project Experience in one or more of the following:

- Machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, ONNX, TensorFlow, or JAX

role: Winter 2027: Software Developer Co-op, Front End (8 months)
jd:
Overview

About our Emerging Talent Program:

Intuit invests in Emerging Talent because fresh perspectives strengthen our products and teams. The program is backed by a culture that values curiosity and collaboration, and you'll be supported by dedicated managers and mentors who are invested in your growth. As an intern or co-op, you'll work on meaningful projects with business impact, many centered on AI and emerging technologies, and contribute to driving decisions. You'll build skills through function-specific learning opportunities, connect with a global community of interns and co-ops through dedicated programming and social events, and get exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional work across Intuit's product ecosystem. Learn more about our Intern and Co-op Program here.

This co-op opportunity invites you to be a part of the team that provides the server-driven UI platform capabilities for web, iOS and Android for Intuit’s multi-billion dollar applications, QuickBooks and TurboTax, to provide dynamic experiences to our customers. We are even open source!

As a co-op on this team, you’ll build front-end and mobile experiences used by millions of consumers and small businesses. Your skills and interests will shape your projects, so you can land where you make a real impact.

Responsibilities



- Build front-end and mobile experiences: Design, develop, and test responsive, high-quality UI components for web (ReactJS) and mobile (iOS and Android) using a server-driven UI platform.
- Work across the stack: Use Java and cloud-based APIs to integrate front-end and mobile experiences with backend services.
- Collaborate on design and architecture: Join technical discussions, contribute to design decisions, and work closely with designers, UX specialists, and backend engineers.
- Ensure quality: Write tests, take part in code reviews, and debug and resolve defects.
- Support our tools and pipelines: Help maintain and improve our CI/CD pipelines and developer tooling.
- Contribute to planning: Help gather requirements, define technical specifications, and create test plans. 
- Drive continuous improvement: Learn new technologies, share what you learn, and explore innovative solutions, including AI-assisted development.

Qualifications



- Actively enrolled in a post-secondary education program.
- A graduation date after the co-op term ends.
- Available for an 8 month (January - August 2027) co-op work term for 40 hours per week
- Must be legally eligible to work in Canada for the duration of the co-op term, without requiring sponsorship now or in the future.
- Ability to work in our Toronto office a minimum of 3 days per week.
- Front-end fundamentals. Experience building responsive, dynamic web applications with ReactJS and a solid grasp of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript/TypeScript.
- Java proficiency. Experience with Java and object-oriented design, plus core data structures and programming concepts.
- Mobile exposure. Experience developing for iOS or Android (Swift, Kotlin, Java, or Objective-C) or with cross-platform frameworks such as React Native or Flutter. Coursework and personal projects count.
- Collaboration across disciplines. You work well with designers, UX specialists, and backend engineers, and you care about the customer experience you’re building.
- AI fluency, with healthy skepticism. You’re comfortable using AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and agentic coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor) to build and prototype, and you check the output rather than take it at face value.
- Problem-solving and debugging. You break down ambiguous problems in a structured way and know when to ask for help.
- Ownership and growth mindset. You take projects from start to finish, communicate progress clearly, and keep learning.
- Nice to have: Familiarity with git, Agile practices, cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), or open-source contributions.

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

The Expected Base Pay Range For This Position Is

Toronto $66,000 - $125,500

Responsibilities

The Global Payment-Tech-Infra and SRE team is responsible for building and maintaining the core infrastructure and reliability engineering capabilities of ByteDance's Global Payment platform. We focus on system architecture, scalability, and operational excellence to support global payment services at scale. As a team, we collaborate closely with business, compliance, and cross-functional engineering teams to drive continuous improvement in system resilience and engineering efficiency.

We are looking for talented individuals to join us for an internship. Our internship program offers students hands-on experience, industry exposure, and opportunities to apply their knowledge to real-world challenges while building a strong foundation for personal and professional growth.

Interns will gain practical experience, explore potential career paths, and participate in social events, learning programs, and development workshops alongside industry professionals.

Candidates may apply to a maximum of two positions across Our Company and its affiliates globally. Applications will be considered in the order they are submitted.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply early. Please clearly state your availability in your resume, including your start and end dates.



-  Participate in the design, development, and evolution of the Global Payment Business Architecture, supporting the continuous growth of global payment services, regulatory compliance, and system modernization while ensuring high-quality architecture delivery and engineering efficiency.
-  Develop a deep understanding of global payment business scenarios and continuously evolve the Global Payment Business Architecture by aligning with business growth and regulatory requirements. Design and build core architectural capabilities, including Multi-Region / Multi-Cell architecture, high availability and disaster recovery, traffic routing, and data synchronization, to continuously improve system reliability, scalability, and evolvability.
-  Drive the governance and continuous improvement of the Global Payment Business Architecture through architecture governance, technology cost optimization, technical standards, and metadata management, continuously enhancing system maintainability, engineering productivity, and architecture governance.

-  Currently pursuing a Undergraduate in Computer Science or a related technical discipline.
-  Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Java, Go, C++, or Python.
-  Solid foundation in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and databases.


Preferred Qualifications



-  Good understanding of the subjects of Machine Learning, Model Training and Evaluation etc.
-  Strong problem-solving ability and ownership mindset. Good cross-functional communication and collaboration skills.
